gate1_secondary_exploratory_quick.note: quick=True forces n_repeats=1 and hyperparameter_max_combos=2 (see quick_overrides). That — not a different n_estimators grid — explains exploratory early+math+behavioral recall~0.67 vs locked confirm pool-sim ~0.89.

gap_explanation: The 0.667 figure came from experiments/gate1_secondary_exploratory (--quick, n_repeats=1, truncated inner search). The 0.892 figure is pool-sim on locked confirm OOF (n_repeats=3, full inner LOFO). Primary gate1_zero_cost (math+behavioral) used n_repeats=3, quick=false, and the same ExtraTrees hyperparameter grid as the locked confirm.
